components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The normal high-priority action in application pages.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:6px 16px; border:1px solid var(--accent); border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); font:600 14px 'Be Vietnam Pro',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--accent-hover); border-color:var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A compact bordered action for routine and secondary tasks.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:6px 16px; border:1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); font:500 14px 'Be Vietnam Pro',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:var(--ink-3); background:var(--surface-2); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The shared compact form control with an indigo focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; color:var(--ink-2); font:600 12.5px 'Be Vietnam Pro',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width:260px; padding:6px 12px; border:1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); font:400 14px 'Be Vietnam Pro',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color:var(--accent); outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft); }

components.name: Accent Chip
components.description: A compact selected-state or contextual label.
components.css: .ds-chip-accent { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:1px 8px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:10px; background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); font:500 12.5px 'Be Vietnam Pro',system-ui,sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Application Card
components.description: A restrained bordered container for application content.
components.css: .ds-card { width:280px; padding:16px; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(21,21,40,.05); font:400 14px/1.55 'Be Vietnam Pro',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; } .ds-card p { margin:0; color:var(--ink-2); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The selected destination in the shared application rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:7px 12px; border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--accent); text-decoration:none; font:600 14px 'Be Vietnam Pro',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--ink); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Executive Insight Row
components.description: One of at most three evidence-led operational findings, with source and direct action.
components.html:
Tổng đơn cần đối chiếu

Sale và Vận đơn chênh 12 đơn trong kỳ.

Nguồn: Sale Canada · Vận đơn mới
Mở dữ liệu
components.css: .ds-exec-insight { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; gap:16px; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-left:3px solid var(--warning); border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); } .ds-exec-insight h3,.ds-exec-insight p { margin:0 0 4px; } .ds-exec-insight small { color:var(--ink-muted); } .ds-exec-insight a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Spreadsheet Export Button
components.description: The brass primary action inside the dark spreadsheet frame.
components.css: .ds-sheet-export { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:30px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:8px; background:linear-gradient(105deg,#f7e7b2,#e8c874 25%,#bb913f 52%,#e8c874 78%,#f7e7b2); color:#241a05; font:600 13px 'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-sheet-export:hover { border-color:#d8b45c; } .ds-sheet-export:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #d8b45c; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Spreadsheet Cell
components.description: A dense cream grid cell with the KN CRM gold current-cell state.
components.css: .ds-sheet-cell { position:relative; width:120px; height:25px; padding:0 6px; display:flex; align-items:center; overflow:hidden; border-right:1px solid #e6e0d1; border-bottom:1px solid #e6e0d1; background:#fffdf8; color:#1f2937; font:400 13px/1.3 'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-sheet-cell:hover { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(184,149,43,.45); } .ds-sheet-cell:focus { outline:none; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #b8952b; }

narrative.northStar: Solarpunk Office — xanh rừng, sage, kem, ánh sáng kiến trúc ấm
narrative.overview: Thiết kế đã duyệt cho nhánh codex/ui-solarpunk, ADR-027. ERP có header và dock nhóm với vùng bố cục riêng; CRM giữ cây điều hướng. Báo cáo hai vùng. Cả hai lưới có focus trong tab, công cụ theo yêu cầu, cùng node trạng thái lưu. Giữ quyền, nghiệp vụ, dữ liệu và định dạng ô. Light mặc định, tôn trọng lựa chọn dark. Django Admin không đổi.
keyCharacteristics: Fine borders and tonal layering before shadow.
Restrained indigo for normal application actions; brass only for KN identity and spreadsheet emphasis.
A dark spreadsheet frame around a light cream grid, independent of the selected app theme.
Vietnamese labels in Be Vietnam Pro; numerical and technical metadata use tabular or monospaced text.

rules.name: Báo cáo ERP — 16.09.2026
rules.body: Tổng hợp dùng bộ lọc bên trái bật/tắt được, bảng kẻ ô cuộn riêng bên phải, tổng ở đầu và cột Team/nhân sự khi nhóm theo người. Toàn màn hình bảng chiếm vùng tab, ẩn header/dock/nền; thanh gọn giữ bộ lọc/xuất/thoát, Esc đóng panel trước rồi thoát; giữ dữ liệu và lựa chọn. Mobile thường xếp một cột, trong focus mở panel cuộn riêng. Tìm tên không dấu không tự áp lọc; đổi nguồn loại ID người/team cũ. Báo cáo ngày Vận đơn dùng form và lịch sử hiện có với nội dung công việc, kết quả, vướng mắc; không có chỉ tiêu tiền/đối soát. Local xem thử, chưa nghiệm thu domain thật.

rules.name: Vận đơn mới — inline editing, 11.09.2026
rules.body: ADR-021 overrides legacy grid controls for van_don_moi: default 28px rows with per-user resizing, blue selection, no free formulas. The value editor stays inside its cell and never covers the next row; long-content reader and protected detail/assignment dialogs remain separate. Tab/Enter and range paste retain autosave and CAS.

rules.name: The Two-Layer Workspace Rule
rules.body: The application shell may follow light or dark theme tokens, but spreadsheet cells remain a warm light surface so editing and scanning are stable across themes.

rules.name: The Brass Restraint Rule
rules.body: Brass marks KN identity and spreadsheet emphasis; ordinary product actions remain indigo.

rules.name: The Utility Type Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for identifiers, figures, and compact structural labels; ordinary Vietnamese prose stays in the sans-serif body face.

rules.name: The Grid Owns Overflow Rule
rules.body: Dense spreadsheet content preserves column width and scrolls inside its workspace; the overall document must not be widened to fit the sheet.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Floating Rule
rules.body: Borders and background steps define normal structure; pronounced shadows are reserved for content that truly overlays the workspace.

rules.name: The Evidence-Before-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Executive insights show situation, evidence, source, and a direct data action; chart perspective is decorative only and never changes the data-bearing face.

rules.name: System Report Fields and Date Display
rules.body: ERP/CRM date inputs display DD/MM/YYYY; transport remains ISO. New reports show readonly Vietnam today and current identity. Submitted reports expose an amendment action only for the approved team/department/admin scope; preserve owner/date and show revision history. ADR-032, 16/09/2026.

dos: Do use the shared neutral/indigo tokens for ordinary application pages and controls.
Do keep the KN CRM grid cream and legible in both light and dark shell modes.
Do preserve the compact spreadsheet measurements, sticky headers, rectangular selection outline, and horizontal overflow behavior.
Do use tabular or monospaced text for codes and figures where alignment improves scanning.
Do keep visible keyboard focus and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do keep executive insights to three or fewer and provide a tabular alternative for every chart.
donts: Don't use brass as a replacement for the normal indigo application action color.
Don't turn Vận đơn's green grouped headers into a global brand or navigation color.
Don't render the spreadsheet as floating cards or loosen its row density into a dashboard layout.
Don't add decorative shadows to resting surfaces; reserve strong elevation for overlays.
Don't repeat one KPI across cards and charts merely to fill the executive dashboard.
